children: Overview
Italy fresh produce distributor's 9M 2026 revenue grew 2.1% year-over-year
Adjusted EBITDA margin for 9M 2026 declined to 4.9% from 5.8% a year ago
Company cites higher energy, warehouse, and general costs, and lower banana volumes for margin drop
Outlook
Orsero confirms its full-year 2026 objectives
Company says it is pursuing expansion projects and AI adoption for process efficiency
Result Drivers
HIGHER COSTS - Co said increased energy, warehouse, and general expenses weighed on margins
HIGHER VALUE CATEGORIES - Revenue growth in distribution was driven by higher prices and volumes in high-value categories such as berries, exotic fruits, and kiwis
